tools.name: resident-trainer
tools.problem: Train added shared-expert neurons inside a live tensor-parallel MoE server without downtime and without changing base weights
tools.status: Ran live on the origin setup; CPU tests pass; engine glue reference-only
tools.standalone_reason: Learning inside live serving with no downtime and a proof that base weights never change; the core breakthrough.

tools.name: paired-job-start
tools.problem: Start, pause and finish a side job in lockstep on two TP ranks inside live serving
tools.status: Protocol ran live inside the resident trainer; extracted version CPU-tested only
tools.tested_on: origin setup (as part of resident-trainer) + CPU tests
tools.standalone_reason: The enabling coordination pattern for any side job in a live TP server; best published together with hot-load as one repo.

tools.name: hot-load
tools.problem: Change running code on all ranks without a restart, executing exactly the hashed bytes
tools.status: Used live on the origin setup; extracted version CPU-tested only
tools.tested_on: origin setup (as part of resident-trainer) + CPU tests
tools.standalone_reason: Pairs with paired-job-start: no-restart code changes across ranks; publish together.

tools.name: trainer-memory-budget

tools.status: Ran live inside the resident trainer; extracted version CPU-tested only
tools.tested_on: origin setup (as part of resident-trainer) + CPU tests
